title: Bench 01 / S1-A: one flex channel (LEFT thumb, GPIO1)
notes: PalmPilot LEFT hand, bench plan on a full breadboard. Pins match the PalmPilot pin map (docs/wiring/README.md) and docs/wiring/README.md; not checked on hardware. + rails = this board's 3V3, - rails = its GND; the right-end jumpers join the bottom rails to the top ones. Never join supplies across boards. The flex sensors sit on the glove: their two leads come to the rail hole and the node hole shown. IMU: leave 3Vo, INT1/INT2/INTM/DRDY and the address pads unconnected. Do not use GPIO0/3/45/46 (strapping), GPIO19/20 (native USB), GPIO43/44 (UART0 bridge). GPIO10 is reserved for battery sense: leave it disconnected. The ENABLE button is added at bench 05; GPIO7 stays unconnected until then.
